description: A stylesheet for styling the React frontend of a two-player Tic Tac Toe game, defining various styles for body, containers, titles, links, and hover effects.

classes.name: app-theme
classes.description: Styles for the main application theme, ensuring a minimum height and overall design.

classes.name: center-container
classes.description: A styled container centered on the page, with padding, border-radius, and a shadow effect.

classes.name: main-title
classes.description: Style for the main title of the application, applying font size, color, and margin.

classes.name: subtitle
classes.description: Style for subtitle text, defining color and font size.

classes.name: about-link
classes.description: Styles for the 'About' link, with padding, background color, and hover effects.

classes.name: home-link
classes.description: Styles for the 'Home' link, similar to the about link with specific padding and hover effects.

classes.name: about-desc
classes.description: Styles for the description section of the 'About' section.
